subject: Future Tech
title: Building a Moon Base
description: A micro-lesson that makes Building a Moon Base usable.

hook.text: The Moon is only three days away. It's the logical place to test colony technology before attempting Mars.

buildup.text: NASA's Artemis program aims to establish a permanent lunar presence by the 2030s with the Gateway space station.

discovery.text: A Moon base could test life support, 3D printing with regolith, and food production in low gravity with quick rescue.

twist.text: Lunar nights last 14 Earth days. Temperatures drop to minus 173°C, requiring nuclear or stored energy to survive.

climax.text: China and ESA are also planning lunar bases. The Moon may host multiple outposts from different nations by 2040.

punchline.text: The Moon is humanity's practice run for Mars.

quiz.question: How long does a lunar night last?
